'''Zalbar Jyvun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was hiding out on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] with a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives when a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] that tasked by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]] to infiltrate the base and killed him along with most of his troopers.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zalbar Jyvun was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TFsT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zalbar Jyvun was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TFsT" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
